entities.summary: Gabit Makhmutuly Musirepov was a Soviet Kazakh writer, playwright and author of libretto to Kazakh opera Kyz-Zhibek. He was named People's Writer of the Kazakh Soviet Socialist Republic, served as President of the Kazakhstan Writers' Union, and was a member of the Kazakhstan Academy of Sciences.
